The self-commutator has diagonal d_k and only q=n-m offdiagonals. Exact rational/square-root expansions give d_k=-2Q/k^3+6P/k^4+O(k^-5), c_k proportional to -B/k^3 with B=mn(m+n)|ab|; gauging remote chains gives quadratic form sum V_k |x_k|^2 - sum beta_k |x_(k+q)-x_k|^2. The leading V coefficient is 2(B-Q)/k^3 and Q-B=m^3|b|^2(r-n/m)(r-(n/m)^2). The k^-4 critical coefficient W has positive value 4n^2(n-m)^2|b|^2 at lower ratio n/m, but negative -2n^3(n-m)^2|b|^2/m at upper ratio (n/m)^2; remote tent test functions with L approximately K^(3/4) establish infinitely many positive directions at lower endpoint, while negative V tails bound positive index elsewhere. Negative diagonal gives infinitely many negative eigenvalues. T_g Hilbert–Schmidt implies H trace class, trace zero; band-tail norm O(N^-3) and negative separated coordinate compressions give s_j(H) comparable to j^-3 and S_p iff p>1/3. No individual eigenvalue formula or sharp coefficient in s_j claimed.
